[SWS_DM_01078] Clear
DDDIDs
on session change
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04246
⌈
If
DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.checkPerSour-
ceId
is set to true and a diagnostic session change occurs, the DM shall clear all
defined
DDDIDs
that have sourceDataIdentifiers that are no longer supported in the
new session and security level.
⌋
